title: Thrust Pyramid
story:
The engine display shows thrust as a pyramid of stars.

Input: one whole number `N` (1–20), the number of rows.

Output: N rows. Row `i` (counting from 1) has `N − i` spaces and then `2i − 1` stars. No spaces after the stars.

Example: `3` prints
`  *`
` ***`
`*****`
hints: An outer loop for rows; inside it, one loop for spaces and another for stars.
For row i (1 to N): print `n - i` spaces, then `2 * i - 1` stars, then a new line.
Check row 1 for N = 3: 2 spaces and 1 star. Row 3: 0 spaces and 5 stars.
